data.animaCaption: Standing before the stocked metal storage shelves in her classic long-sleeve maid uniform, she lifts her dark grey skirt and white apron while looking down at you with a teasing blush. Warm overhead storage-room light defines the frills of her apron and casts crisp shadows across the shelves.
data.promptProse: Framed from a bold low tilted angle inside Café Stella's narrow supply room lined with metal shelving, Shiki Natsume wears her canonical long-sleeved dark grey maid dress, ruffled white apron, lace headdress, and white knee-high socks. Holding the hem of both skirt and apron lifted cleanly to show pale yellow panties beneath, she gazes down at the viewer with a sly, rosy-cheeked smirk under warm interior overhead light.
data.story: 帮忙清点咖啡豆的储物室里安静得落针可闻。站在金属货架前的夏目唇角微勾，大方提起女仆裙与白围裙一角低头看你，语气带着标志性的促狭——「前辈刚才眼神一直在往哪瞟呢？现在给你看清楚。」
